# FET Black Tie Event

> The Night of Excellence — University of Buea Faculty of Engineering & Technology Black Tie Gala on 4 July 2026 at The Millennium Hall. Reserve tickets and send anonymous shout-outs.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Event details, countdown, ticket tiers and booking.
